changes: Migration reconciliation: databases with pre-existing tables now reconcile without re-running SQL
Fresh installs create all tables and record every migration version
Partial table state raises a clear MigrationConflict with actionable guidance
CREATE TABLE and CREATE INDEX statements are safely skipped when already present
Three new reconciliation tests added (total: 132 tests)
upgrade_notes: Existing databases with pre-rc3 manual fixes now upgrade cleanly. No data is modified during reconciliation.
